Definition: a Erite (collectively) or descendants of Eri
BiblicalUsage: ʻÊrîy is the word for a Erite or descendants of Eri. It occurs just once, in Numbers.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is to take ʻÊrîy at face value and move on to the passage itself.
